blueprint.objective: Assess the risk of onboarding the fictional cloud vendor Nimbus Storage Ltd and produce a justified go / conditional-go / no-go recommendation.

inputs.name: vendor_dossier
inputs.description: Description of the vendor (Nimbus Storage Ltd), its services, and its controls.

tasks.role: Investigate vendor risk across security, financial stability, and regulatory compliance
tasks.responsibility: Read the vendor_dossier and coordinate three specialist sub-investigations (security posture, financial stability, regulatory compliance). Consolidate their findings into a single risk view: a narrative summary, a ranked list of top risks, and an overall risk rating.

subagents.responsibility: Investigate the 'security' aspect of: Read the vendor_dossier and coordinate three specialist sub-investigations (security posture, financial stability, regulatory compliance). Consolidate their findings into a single risk view: a narrative summary, a ranked list of top risks, and an overall risk rating.

Investigate the 'financial_stability' aspect of: Read the vendor_dossier and coordinate three specialist sub-investigations (security posture, financial stability, regulatory compliance). Consolidate their findings into a single risk view: a narrative summary, a ranked list of top risks, and an overall risk rating.

Investigate the 'regulatory_compliance' aspect of: Read the vendor_dossier and coordinate three specialist sub-investigations (security posture, financial stability, regulatory compliance). Consolidate their findings into a single risk view: a narrative summary, a ranked list of top risks, and an overall risk rating.

tasks.responsibility: Using the consolidated risk view from risk_investigation, produce a final decision (go, conditional go, or no-go), any conditions that must be met, and a justification that explicitly ties the decision back to the identified top risks.
